_comment: Dedicated paired ToolSearch matrix. Cases contain no credentials, commands, environment injection, or external URLs. Browser is deliberately Web-only and receives a runner-owned loopback fixture URL; ACP deliberately has no Browser tools.

cases.title: Direct tool succeeds without ToolSearch
cases.prompt: Read direct_fixture.txt and answer with exactly the token stored in that file. Do not modify any file.

cases.title: Irrelevant English request uses no tools
cases.prompt: Reply with exactly NO_TOOL_OK. This is a self-contained response: do not inspect files and do not call any tool.

cases.title: Irrelevant Chinese request uses no tools
cases.prompt: 只回复精确文本：无需工具。这个问题不需要读取文件，也不要调用任何工具。

cases.title: Exact select discovers one Deferred tool
cases.prompt: Call the tool named goal_get exactly once and report whether this isolated session currently has a goal. Do not call goal_set or goal_update.

cases.title: English semantic search discovers goal status
cases.prompt: Use the session facility that reads the current persistent objective and its status. Tell me whether one exists. Do not create, replace, complete, or block an objective.

cases.title: Chinese semantic search discovers goal status
cases.prompt: 请使用能够读取当前会话持久目标及其状态的功能，告诉我现在是否已设置目标。不要创建、替换、完成或阻塞目标。

cases.title: Multi-target goal lifecycle preserves activation boundary
cases.prompt: Set the persistent session objective to exactly MULTI_TARGET_GOAL_OK, read it back to verify it, and then mark it complete. Perform those three operations in that dependency order.

cases.title: Deferred tool receives complex weekly schedule arguments
cases.prompt: Propose a disabled weekly automation named TS_WEEKLY_COMPLEX_OK. Its task prompt must be exactly REVIEW_FIXTURE_ONLY. Schedule it every Monday at 09:35 in the current isolated project. Do not enable or run it.

cases.title: MCP exact routing among 10 similar tools
cases.prompt: Fetch the authoritative exact catalog record for external SKU SKU-TS-10. Do not use preview, full-text search, inventory, metadata, price, policy, recent, supplier, or customer lookup. Use request id mcp-10 and request a limit of exactly 3.

cases.title: MCP exact routing among 30 similar and filler tools
cases.prompt: Fetch the authoritative exact catalog record for external SKU SKU-TS-30. Do not use a preview, full-text search, inventory lookup, or any generic utility. Use request id mcp-30 and request a limit of exactly 3.

cases.title: MCP exact routing among 50 similar and filler tools
cases.prompt: Fetch the authoritative exact catalog record for external SKU SKU-TS-50. Do not use a preview, full-text search, inventory lookup, or any generic utility. Use request id mcp-50 and request a limit of exactly 3.

cases.title: MCP exact routing among 100 similar and filler tools
cases.prompt: Fetch the authoritative exact catalog record for external SKU SKU-TS-100. Do not use a preview, full-text search, inventory lookup, or any generic utility. Use request id mcp-100 and request a limit of exactly 3.

cases.title: Computer fixture routes open and act through Deferred disclosure
cases.prompt: Using the deterministic native-computer fixture, open Notes (com.apple.Notes), inspect its current UI, and click the New Note button using its current uid. Browser tools are intentionally unavailable on this ACP surface.

cases.title: Web-only Browser tools complete a driver-owned loopback proof form
cases.prompt: Use Browser tools to open the driver-owned proof form at {BROWSER_FIXTURE_URL}, snapshot it, fill and submit its one-time proof value, then read the confirmation marker. Do not navigate anywhere else.

cases.title: Unknown exact select fails closed without target execution
cases.prompt: Use tool search once to look for the exact deferred name mcp__toolsearch_fixture__does_not_exist. If it is unavailable, call no other tool and reply exactly UNKNOWN_TOOL_OK.

cases.title: Unrelated keyword search activates no Deferred tool
cases.prompt: Use tool search once for a live interplanetary weather radar. This isolated fixture has no such capability. When no relevant tool is found, call no other tool and reply exactly NO_RELEVANT_TOOL_OK.
